_comment: The vignettes' own meeting scenes (Expansion 6 C.9; situations.vignettes.json meetings v_...). Cast roles and given words come from the situation (its roles, its words: {ruin}, {water}, the plea).

vig_drowned_bell.about: A bell rings somewhere under the water, though there is no bell; the oldest one in town stops in the street, and then comes to you.

toll: Somewhere under {water}, a bell rings. There is no bell in {town}.
A bell tolls, low and slow, from the direction of {water}. Nobody in the street looks up but one.
Out of {water} comes the sound of a bell, drowned and patient.
hush: Do you hear it? Tell me you hear it.
open: You heard it too. I saw your face.
Not everyone can hear it. You can.
